create_labgraph_monitor_node: create a LabgraphMonitorNode instance with a given name for graph monitoring
set_node_grouping: set the grouping property on a LabgraphMonitorNode to logically group methods sharing the same process
set_node_in_edge: set the in_edge property on a LabgraphMonitorNode to subscribe to a topic path
set_upstream_node: set the upstream_node property on a LabgraphMonitorNode to link an adjacent data source node
set_upstream_message: set the upstream_message property on a LabgraphMonitorNode to store a received LabgraphMonitorMessage
